278670097.description: This listing includes two vintage tobacco pipes. The first is a Stanwell Selected Briar 90, handmade in Denmark with a bent stem and a worn finish that shows signs of age. The second pipe is a Longchamp France model wrapped in leather with visible stitching and some wear on both the wood and leather. Both pipes are structurally intact and display typical wear consistent with their vintage nature.

278722737.description:
Hand-carved meerschaum pipe featuring a detailed bearded man's face on the bowl. This vintage piece includes a multi-part construction with a threaded stem and a protective storage case.
Material: Meerschaum bowl with wooden and horn-style stem components
Design: Figural carving of a bearded man
Construction: Three-piece design with threaded connections
Includes: Original black hardshell storage case
Signature: Visible engraving on the shank near the threading
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage condition. The meerschaum bowl shows characteristic yellowing and surface wear consistent with age and use, including a dark burn mark on the side of the carving. The stem shows signs of wear at the connection points. Please see photos for details.

GE (General Electric) corporate logo enamel emblems on clips

Instrument length: 5.25 inches

Emblems are intact and well-defined.
